reason: Multiple reports specifically identify parliamentary speaker Ghalibaf as leading Iran's side in existing US backchannel talks and describe Washington as treating him as a workable senior interlocutor. Araghchi remains the conventional choice to lead a formal diplomatic delegation, but 80% on him was no longer calibrated given the direct Ghalibaf reporting.

Operational reporting calls Khiam the strategic focus and describes a major battle in and around the town. Later reporting places Israeli forces near Qantara, farther toward the Litani, implying that Khiam may be bypassed or encircled; Qantara is added because it lies directly on the advancing eastern axis.
